newsitem.title: USA: GPU restores 850 Pa. coal-fired power unit.
newsitem.headline: GPU restores 850 Pa. coal-fired power unit.

text.p: GPU Generation Inc said Wednesday it restored a 850 megawatt (MW) unit at the Conemaugh coal-fired generating facility to operation Tuesday after a brief outage.
"It was up as of 1515 (EST)," a company spokeswoman said.
Conemaugh's unit 1 tripped off line early Tuesday following a turbine control problem.
The neigboring Conemaugh unit 2 was running at 100 percent of its 850 MW capacity, the spokeswoman said.
The Conemaugh power units are jointly owned by utilities in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland Interconnect pool.
The Conemaugh complex is operated by GPU Generation, a subsidiary of GPU Inc of Parisippany, N.J.
